newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian wool prices seen strengthening - ACWE.
newsitem.headline: Australian wool prices seen strengthening - ACWE.

text.p: Australian wool prices are expected to strengthen at auctions in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle when sales resume this week after last week's break, the Australian Council of Wool Exporters (ACWE) said.
The 114,300 bale offering includes 17,242 bales more than the original roster that have been attracted to auction by firmer market prices, the ACWE said in its weekly market preview.
But Wesfarmers Dalgety Ltd cautioned that the large offering may cause a slight correction.
"However, the recently stimulated business is expected to support prices in the short term and the outlook for the rest of the season remains generally positive," Wesfarmers said.
The eastern market rose 15 cents to 675 cents a kg clean while the western market fell two cents to 629 cents a kg clean at the last sales two weeks ago.
